bdud 'dul ma hā gu ru drag por sgrub pa'i skong bshags bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru padmā ka ra ya/'dir ma hā gu ru drag por sgrub pa'i phrin las kyi

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bdud 'dul ma hā gu ru drag por sgrub pa'i skong bshags bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru padmā ka ra ya/

'dir ma hā gu ru drag por sgrub pa'i phrin las kyi kha skong skong ba byed par 'dod na/ skong rdzas byin rlabs ni/ tshogs byin rlabs la 'don pa kha bsgyur bar bya ste/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis skong rdzas kyi// dngos 'dzin 'bag btsog ser sna sbyangs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'dod yon gyi// phung po zag med bdud rtsir spel// zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ hrīḥ mchod bya mchod byed gnyis med pa'i// chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i ngang*// rang byung lhun grub mchod sprin gyis// skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*/ dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du// padma las 'khrungs padma'i rgyal// rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// 'chi med bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ de nyid gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// che mchog rdo rje srin po'i skur// bzhengs pa rdo rje khro bo lod// padma drag po'i thugs dam bskang/ rigs bdag bde chen zhing gi mgon// dpag med tshe 'od mnga' ba yi// ka dag gdod nas byang chub pa// snang mtha' yas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ thugs dang ye shes sems dpa' ni// mtsho rgyal ma dang gnyis med sbyor// bde chen longs spyod yongs rdzogs pa// padma thod phreng thugs dam bskang*// dbu gtsug klu gdon gdug pa 'dul// mthing nag mkha' lding chen po'i gzugs// rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba can// ga ru ṭa yi thugs dam bskang*// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i shar rtsibs la// rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rdo rje// zhe sdang gdug pa 'joms byed pa// phyag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*// lho phyogs rgyal kun yon tan bdag /nga rgyal bdud dang 'chi bdag 'joms// gshin rje'i gshed du rab grags pa'i/ khro bo chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// nub phyogs rgyal kun gsung gi bdag /'dod chags bdud tshogs 'joms byed pa/ khams gsum dbang sdud khro bo'i rgyal// dbang chen rta mgrin thugs dam bskang*// byang phyogs sprul pa'i gnod sbyin che// rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las bdag

/phrag dog gdug pa 'joms pa'i dpal// me dbal chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// mtshams bzhir phrin las bzhi yi bdag /dga' bzhi'i bde chen ye shes spel// rdo rje rin chen padma las// mkha' 'gro bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*/ 'khor yug sgrol ba'i 'khor tshogs ni// rig 'dzin ḍā ki dam can dang*// gter srung klu bdud btsan gsum sogs// bka' nyan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// mar me dri zhal rol mo dang*// bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad la sogs// zhi byed zhi ba'i mchod pa 'dis// 'khor bcas thugs dam gnyan bskangs pas// nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen tshogs// da lta nyid du zhi bar mdzod// bdud rtsi rakta gtor ma'i tshogs// rin chen rgyan phreng lhab lhub dar// rgyal srid rin chen bdun la sogs// rgyas chen rgyas pa'i mchod pa 'dis// 'khor bcas thugs dam gnyan bskangs pas// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang*// yon tan ye shes phrin las sogs// rab tu rgyas shing 'phel bar mdzod// padma can dang dung can sogs// bde ba chen pos dgyes skyed pa'i// rig ma rnams dang dbang byed rdzas// gzugs sgra dri ro reg yon tan// phul du byung ba'i mchod sprin 'dis// 'khor bcas thugs dam gnyan bskangs pas/ khams gsum srid gsum 'jig rten kun// dbang du 'dus pa'i phrin las mdzod// rdo rje ral gri gri gug sogs// mtshon cha rab tu 'bar ba dang*// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// las byung nyer spyod 'dod yon tshogs// drag po'i mchod pa dpag med kyis// 'khor bcas thugs dam gnyan bskangs pas// bstan dang bdag la 'tshe byed pa'i// dgra bgegs gnod byed brlag par mdzod// hūm̐/ dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams// gsan cing bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag sogs las ngan gyis mnar bas// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams// bskyed rim ma gsal sngags ma dag

/yid 'khrul nyon mongs dbang du shor// sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba sogs// gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol lo bshags/ khyad par bsnyen sgrub tshad ma phyin// bstan la mi sems rang 'dod kyis// chags sdang dbang gis khro rgyal bskul// phrin las sbyor ba brtsams pa sogs// tshor dang ma tshor rmongs dbang gis// nongs pa cung zad gang mchis pa// thugs rje can rnams bzod bzhes la// dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub stsol// de ltar bskang zhing bshags pa'i mthus// bdud 'dul drag po'i zhal mthong nas// las dang dngos grub thogs med 'grub// phyogs las rnam par rgyal gyur cig / ces pa 'di rig 'dzin ha ya grī ba na thas bskul ba'i ngor dang*/ rgyal dbang mchog gis bka' phebs pa la brten nas/ si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis lcags yos lo mgo zla'i dmar phyogs la bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
